title: Brain Tumour Report
description: Segment contrast-enhancing brain tumours on a native-space T1c MRI with Raidionics v1.3 and compute native morphometry and MNI RADS anatomical reports.

analyze.title: Segment and characterize tumour
analyze.description: Segment the brain and contrast-enhancing tumour core on a T1c MRI (or characterize an optional native-space binary mask) and return masks, per-lesion morphometry, and optional MNI ICBM152 RADS overlap, tract distances and glioblastoma resectability.

t1c.description: Native-space 3D post-contrast T1-weighted MRI (NIfTI or DICOM series)

mask.description: Optional binary tumour mask aligned to the T1c image; when provided, segmentation is skipped and the supplied mask is characterized directly

tumourType.description: Tumour type context for reporting; Glioblastoma additionally reports the Kommers et al. (2021) resectability index.

computeMniReport.description: Register the brain-masked T1c to MNI ICBM152 2009a with Greedy and compute laterality, cortical overlap, subcortical tract distances and resectability.

deformableMni.description: Refine MNI registration with lesion-masked deformable Greedy SVF (NMI); slower than affine-only registration.

skullStripped.description: Enable when the input T1c is already skull-stripped; uses non-zero voxels as the brain mask instead of running MRI_Brain.

backend.description: Requested ONNX inference backend; WebGPU falls back to WebAssembly CPU when unavailable or storage limits are too small.
